scope: load real 1.8B checkpoint + single 4-token batched-prefill forward vs D-1 fp32 golden
backend: mlx-swift-lm HunyuanModel (research probe only, NOT wired into HymnTranslate)

d1_reference.weight_source: weights.fp16.bin (same bit patterns as fp32 golden)

precision_note: MLX uses affine INT4 -> bf16 dequantization; D-1 and the fp32 golden share the same fp16 weight cache. Two different weight-precision paths explain MLX's larger elementwise error; argmax and top-20 remain consistent.
measurement_note: single-run measurements; forward_ms is 4-token prefill, NOT tokens/s and NOT TTFT
